title: Dev: Medtrum pump description is wrong
body:
After f583a6cb1454dae8453cc91bb777cc1561720874

The reservoir reading in status bar is incorrect:
![WhatsApp Image 2024-09-29 at 20 28 32(1)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1800c74f-6eca-41e6-8806-f386f83094ce)
![WhatsApp Image 2024-09-29 at 20 28 32](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9c3856d-0e32-4b7d-8ba8-1736b0bda5b2)

This is due to the pump type being dynamicly updated by the driver but this is not represented to AAPS because the get() was removed.

I'm not sure if this is a problem for other pump drivers, hence the issue.
